sourceMarkup: {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Skill Credit |image = SkillCredit.png |type = Evergreen }} ==Description== '''Skill Credits''' are a currency only obtained by reseting the [[Skills|Skill]] tree. Once reset, 95% of the {{Coins|Coins}} spent on [[Skills]] will be turned into '''Skill Credits''', which can only be used to upgrade [[Skills]]. This currency can only be seen in the [[Skills]] menu. It takes the appearance of a hexagon coin with an upward arrow on it. ==Update History== *'''13 June 2025''' - [[v1.67.3]] **'''Skill Credits''' added. {{CurrencyNavBox}}
